forecourt: Standard IndianOil RVI (Retail Visual Identity) canopy present. Kerbside Parking available, though heavily constrained by junction traffic. Ingress/Egress Risk: The junction connects 5 roads. Police barricades and 'illegal parking' often obstruct flow. Traffic Jams: During peak season (April-May), navigating the 1km stretch can take 1 hour. This severely impacts the station's ability to process vehicles. One-Way Systems: Police frequently enforce circular one-way traffic during peak season, which can either funnel traffic *into* or *away from* the station depending on the routing enforcement.
